source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eleven Watson Development rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Watson Central Cubelife's hotel role is corroborated by the official Night City Atlas. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: City Tot Daycare
entities.source_summary: Neighborhood childcare business charging reasonable rates; the source also identifies it as a cover for Arzin Tynon smuggling activity.

entities.name: FūdHouse
entities.source_summary: Watson branch of a Continental Brands fast-food chain serving standardized boxed meals and fountain drinks, with an in-store Segotari claw machine.

entities.name: Hammered Up Liquor
entities.source_summary: Hammered Industries liquor outlet selling the company's inexpensive proprietary alcoholic mixes; related Hammered Up vendits are also common around the city.

entities.name: Joint Temporary Housing Solution
entities.source_summary: Shared Petrochem and SovOil temporary employee housing; the source does not establish public lodging or rental service.

entities.name: NeoSoviet Consulate
entities.source_summary: NeoSoviet diplomatic compound; unlike other source entries that spell out customer-facing consular transactions, this entry does not establish a Vend-R-relevant public service.

entities.name: The Obituary
entities.source_summary: Dragula Racers gang base and vehicle storage site; no public shop or paid service is established.

entities.name: Petrochem Oil Refinery
entities.source_summary: Petrochem industrial refining facility rather than a customer-facing retail or service point.

entities.name: The Pochinko Carnival
entities.source_summary: Carnival offering games and nightly Canadian-clowning entertainment; it also pays a small bounty for a genuine Bozo nose.

purchase_policy.label: Bounty for a genuine Bozo nose

entities.name: SkidRow Limited
entities.source_summary: Fashion design company and brand location; this entry does not establish a public storefront, showroom, or direct customer service.

entities.name: SovOil Oil Refinery
entities.source_summary: SovOil industrial refining facility rather than a customer-facing retail or service point.

entities.name: Watson Central Cubelife
